source: OpenAI API Standard text-token reference prices
assumptions: Rates are USD per one million text tokens, checked against the official model pages on 2026-09-12. Model names map explicitly; there is no guessed alias or fallback price.

Reference scenario: Standard service and at most 272000 input tokens per request. Cached input is priced as a cache read; the remaining input uses the uncached rate. Reasoning tokens are already included in output.
This is an OpenAI API reference estimate, not a charge from the configured gateway or subscription. Local computation and separate tool charges are excluded.
uncertainties: Saved usage does not establish every request's service tier, long-context bracket or cache-write quantity. Standard/base-context reference rates are assumed; thread-cumulative input is never treated as one request's context length.

The official pages apply higher rates above 272000 request input tokens and a 1.25x uncached-input rate for cache writes; Batch/Flex and Fast modes have different multipliers. These unobserved adjustments are not included, so the reference estimate is partial and not a guaranteed lower bound.
